title: Judicial review of determinations.
officialText:
Notwithstanding any other provision of law to the contrary, decisions, orders and
interpretations of the commissioner made pursuant to this chapter shall not be subject to review by the board of standards and
appeals. Final decisions and orders of the commissioner made pursuant to this chapter shall be subject to review pursuant to article 78
of the civil practice law and rules.
